verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software or automation platform. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships a user-facing automation tool: the legaltech page describes the firm's own internal AI use, and Prarambh is a startup incubator.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
